security.account.credits_eff: The passphrase generator in the vault's core draws its words from the EFF large word list by the Electronic Frontier Foundation, used under the CC BY 3.0 US licence. The dice numbers were removed from the list; the words are unchanged.
security.account.heading: Account
security.account.intro: Settings that change how your vault opens ask for your master password again first.
security.account.menu_empty: There are no account pages in this version.
security.account.reauth_fresh: Your master password was confirmed. Changes that need it go ahead without asking again until about {time}.
security.account.reauth_stale: Your master password has not been confirmed lately. A change that needs it asks for it first.
security.account.title: Account
security.error.body_too_large: The request is larger than the server accepts. Nothing was changed.
security.error.change_unconfirmed: The change may have gone through: the server's answer did not arrive in a form this page can trust. Do not repeat it. Lock the vault and unlock it with the new master password first; if that is refused, the old master password still works.
security.error.decrypt: The current master password or the secret key is not right. Nothing was changed.
security.error.denied: The server refused the change. Nothing was changed. Confirm your master password again and try once more.
security.error.generation_exhausted: This unlock method cannot be renewed any more: its counter is at the limit of the format. Nothing was changed. Tell whoever runs the server.
security.error.password_unchanged: The new master password is the same as the current one. Choose a different one.
security.error.pin_missing: This device has no record of the account. Sign in again.
security.error.pin_save_failed: The server accepted the new master password, but this device could not save its record of the change. The new password works. Sign in again with it to finish.
security.error.reauth_required: The password check has run out of time. Nothing was changed. Confirm your master password again and retry.
security.error.second_factor_required: This account needs a second factor for sensitive changes, and the vault cannot give one in this version. Nothing was changed.
security.error.secret_key_not_held: This device does not hold the secret key of the account, so the full emergency sheet cannot be made here. Type the secret key from page 1 of your sheet, or use a device that remembers it.
security.error.write_conflict: The unlock methods changed on the server while you worked, for example from another device. Nothing was changed. Try again.
security.password.busy: Changing the master password. This takes a few seconds.
security.password.done_backup: The server was asked to make a new backup. It is usually made within a few minutes; until a new backup exists, the newest backup still opens with the old password.
security.password.done_devices: Every other device and browser was signed out. They sign in again with the new password.
security.password.done_old_files: Exports and backups made before the change still open with the old password.
security.password.done_sheet: Your emergency sheet is still valid: the recovery key and the secret key did not change.
security.password.heading: Change master password
security.password.intro: Choose a new master password. You are asked for the current one first. Your secret key and your emergency sheet stay the same.
security.password.new_help: At least 12 characters with a secret key, 15 without. It cannot be recovered if you forget it; the recovery key is the only way back.
security.password.new_help_no_sk: At least 15 characters, because this account has no secret key. It cannot be recovered if you forget it; the recovery key is the only way back.
security.password.new_help_sk: At least 12 characters. It cannot be recovered if you forget it; the recovery key is the only way back.
security.password.old_files: Exports and backups made before the change still open with your old password. Keep the old password until you no longer need those files, or make new ones. Every other device and browser is signed out when the change goes through.
security.password.secret_key_help: This device does not remember the secret key. Type it from page 1 of your emergency sheet. It does not change.
security.password.title: Master password
security.reauth.body: Enter your master password again to continue. This takes a few seconds.
security.reauth.busy: Checking the password. This takes a few seconds.
security.reauth.secret_key_help: This device does not remember the secret key. Type it from page 1 of your emergency sheet.
security.reauth.title: Confirm your master password
